email.subject: Luna Group Hair Studio: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Dev,

I checked Luna Group Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no click-to-call link, so anyone searching on their phone has to copy and dial your number manually (most won't), and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people can't tell if you're open right now and go elsewhere.

Also worth noting: no reviews are shown, which makes it harder for new clients to trust you at a glance.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found, free, 10 minutes, no pitch.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
